transforms.name: present subjunctive passive, 3rd sg
transforms.description: Present subjunctive passive, third person singular: ametur, moneatur, regatur. Also deponents.

transforms.name: present subjunctive passive, 1st pl
transforms.description: Present subjunctive passive, first person plural: amemur, moneamur, regamur. Also deponents.

transforms.name: present subjunctive passive, 2nd pl
transforms.description: Present subjunctive passive, second person plural: amemini, moneamini, regamini. Also deponents.

transforms.name: present subjunctive passive, 3rd pl
transforms.description: Present subjunctive passive, third person plural: amentur, moneantur, regantur. Also deponents.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive passive, 1st sg
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive passive, first person singular: amarer, monerer, regerer. Also deponents.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive passive, 2nd sg
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive passive, second person singular: amareris, monereris, regereris. Also deponents.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive passive, 3rd sg
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive passive, third person singular: amaretur, moneretur, regeretur. Also deponents.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive passive, 1st pl
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive passive, first person plural: amaremur, moneremur, regeremur. Also deponents.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive passive, 2nd pl
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive passive, second person plural: amaremini, moneremini, regeremini. Also deponents.

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive passive, 3rd pl
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive passive, third person plural: amarentur, monerentur, regerentur. Also deponents.

transforms.name: imperative, 2nd sg
transforms.description: Present imperative, second person singular: ama, mone, rege.

transforms.name: imperative, 2nd sg / passive infinitive
transforms.description: Present imperative, second person singular: ama, mone, rege. Also: passive infinitive.

transforms.name: imperative, 2nd pl
transforms.description: Present imperative, second person plural: amate, monete, regite.

transforms.name: future imperative, 2nd/3rd sg
transforms.description: Future imperative, second and third person singular: amato, moneto, regito.

transforms.name: future imperative, 2nd pl
transforms.description: Future imperative, second person plural: amatote, monetote, regitote.

transforms.name: future imperative, 3rd pl
transforms.description: Future imperative, third person plural: amanto, monento, regunto.

transforms.name: future imperative passive, 2nd/3rd sg
transforms.description: Future imperative passive, second and third person singular: amator, monetor, regitor. Deponent verbs: hortator, veretor, sequitor.

transforms.name: future imperative passive, 3rd pl
transforms.description: Future imperative passive, third person plural: amantor, monentor, reguntor. Deponent verbs: hortantor, verentor, sequuntor.

transforms.name: passive infinitive
transforms.description: Present passive infinitive (also the old forms in -ier): amari, moneri, regi. Deponent verbs: hortari, vereri, sequi.

transforms.name: gerund, genitive
transforms.description: Gerund, genitive: amandi, monendi, regendi. Deponent verbs: hortandi, verendi, sequendi.

transforms.name: gerund, dative/ablative
transforms.description: Gerund, dative and ablative: amando, monendo, regendo. Deponent verbs: hortando, verendo, sequendo.

transforms.name: gerund, accusative
transforms.description: Gerund, accusative (after ad and in): amandum, monendum, regendum. Deponent verbs: hortandum, verendum, sequendum.

transforms.name: present participle
transforms.description: Present active participle (declined as a third-declension adjective): amāns, monēns, regēns, capiēns, audiēns; of deponent verbs hortāns, verēns, sequēns, patiēns, largiēns.

transforms.name: gerundive
transforms.description: Gerundive (future passive participle): amandus, monendus, regendus, capiendus (capiundus), audiendus; of deponent verbs hortandus, verendus, sequendus.

transforms.name: future participle
transforms.description: Future active participle, read through the perfect participle it is made from: ductūrus → ductus, factūrus → factus.

transforms.name: supine in -ū
transforms.description: Supine in -ū (after adjectives): amātū, dictū, factū, vīsū.

transforms.name: perfect participle
transforms.description: Perfect passive participle (of deponent verbs, active in meaning): amātus, monitus, audītus, rēctus; hortātus, veritus, secūtus.

transforms.name: supine
transforms.description: Supine in -um (purpose after verbs of motion): amātum, monitum, audītum, rēctum.

transforms.name: future participle
transforms.description: Future active participle: amātūrus, monitūrus, audītūrus, rēctūrus; hortātūrus, secūtūrus.

transforms.name: present, 2nd sg / imperative, 2nd sg
transforms.description: Present indicative, second person singular: amas, mones, regis. Also: imperative, 2nd sg.

transforms.name: infinitive
transforms.description: Present active infinitive: amare, monere, regere.

transforms.name: future infinitive
transforms.description: Future infinitive of sum: fore (= futūrus esse).

transforms.name: present, 1st sg
transforms.description: Present indicative, first person singular: amo, moneo, rego.

transforms.name: present, 3rd sg / perfect, 3rd sg
transforms.description: Present indicative, third person singular: amat, monet, regit. Also: perfect, 3rd sg.

transforms.name: present passive, 2nd pl
transforms.description: Present indicative passive, second person plural: amamini, monemini, regimini. Also deponents.

transforms.name: -cum
transforms.description: cum written after a personal or relative pronoun: mēcum, tēcum, nōbīscum, quōcum.

transforms.name: -met
transforms.description: The emphatic -met: egomet, mihimet, sēmet.

transforms.name: -nam
transforms.description: The emphatic -nam of questions: quisnam, quidnam, ubinam.

transforms.name: + esse
transforms.description: A participle or gerundive with a form of esse: amātus est, hortātī sunt, amātūrus esse, dēlenda est, laudandum erat; and the supine with īrī, the future passive infinitive (amātum īrī).
